note: Every organisation, place, person, figure and sentence in this file is invented. Hosts use the reserved .example top-level domain. Nothing here is, or is derived from, a real source.

cases.title: Board approval is a condition
cases.rationale: "If approved … may consider" is neither a decision nor an announcement.

documents.title: Board approval is a condition
documents.text: If approved by the board, Halvard Snacks may consider building a new facility in Winterhold, Ohio with up to $200 million in investment.

cases.title: Evaluating sites, no decision
cases.rationale: A company that says it has made no decision has not announced a project, even if a range of states and an amount are mentioned.

documents.title: Evaluating sites, no decision
documents.text: Halvard Snacks is evaluating several sites for a possible new plant and has not made a final decision. Any project in Ohio, Indiana or Kentucky would represent an investment of $150 million or more and would not begin before 2028.

cases.title: Incentive accounting policy
cases.rationale: A note on how incentives are accounted for when facilities are constructed describes a policy, not a project.

documents.title: Incentive accounting policy
documents.text: When constructing new facilities or making major enhancements to existing facilities, the company may receive incentives from state and local governments, which are recorded as a reduction of the cost of the facility in 2027.

cases.title: An anonymous source and a declined comment
cases.rationale: An unattributed report that the company declined to confirm cannot support promotion on its own.

documents.title: An anonymous source and a declined comment
documents.text: According to an anonymous source familiar with the matter, Brindlemoor Foods is planning to build a new plant in Hollis Bay, Ohio worth $300 million. The company declined to comment.
